title: Identity, Diversity, and Team Performance: Evidence from U.S. Mutual Funds
authors: Richard B. Evans; Melissa Porras Prado; Antonino Emanuele Rizzo; Rafael Zambrana
near_miss_reason: The only staggered binary design is the advisor-merger DiD in Table 12 (post x dtreatment, mergers at fund-specific dates). Every column also includes the fund's own post-merger indicator (an extra staggered treatment regressor, DDD structure as in PROTOCOL 5b), team-size FE (fund_n_mgrs) and time-varying fund controls. Not a 5c candidate (violations beyond time-varying controls), and no data are shipped.
eligible_reason: Main analyses regress fund performance on continuous political diversity (fund_diversity) with style x month FE (Tables 1, 3-7, 10, 11): continuous treatment. Table 8 uses holdings-level regressions of new_stocks x funds_diverse_event (or funds_homog_event / funds_event_rep / funds_event_dem) with stock x date and fund FE: subgroup-by-treatment interaction, not a unit-level TWFE. Table 12 (merger quasi-experiment) is staggered and binary but adds the post main effect, team-size FE and controls in every column. No qualifying column.
design_notes: Single Stata do-file (Replication - MS-FIN-22-00544.do). Fund-month panel from CRSP + Morningstar + CRP donations. Table 12: gen post = date > merger_date; reghdfe alpha*/bench_gross_ret/fund_diversity c.post#c.dtreatment post size expense_ratio loads turnover, absorb(crsp_portno date fund_n_mgrs) vce(cl date). Mergers identified from N-SAR item 77.H and Form ADV control-person changes, dated from press searches. dtreatment = 1 if adding a manager with the acquirer's average views would raise target-team diversity.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Merger dates vary by fund; count not verifiable (no data shipped).

data_files_note: ReadMe: 'The journal agreed to a delay of data disclosure of 2 years. The full replication package including the dataset will be released after 6 October 2025.' The archive (zip dated March 2024) contains only the do-file, Python helpers, the Stata log and the ReadMe. Underlying data are CRSP Mutual Fund, Morningstar and holdings data (licensed); CRP donations public.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, estout); Python helpers for diversity measures and benchmark assignment.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Even if the delayed dataset has since been posted on the journal page, no main-text column qualifies (Table 12 has post main effect + team-size FE + controls). Table numbers from the do-file headers and the replication log.
